comments.body: Thanks for trying it. The refusal is expected for now. Convert Mesh only rebuilds closed constant-section parts, where one profile is extruded straight, and it takes up to 50,000 triangles. A 169,000-triangle car body is freeform, so it would be refused at any size. Turning a freeform mesh into smooth surfaces is a different problem, and I'm not planning to take it on soon. #63 tracks how far the conversion will go. Closing this one as not planned. If you have a prismatic part that fails, please open a new issue with the mesh attached.
